refinements.name: 光静花冷
refinements.description: 暴击伤害提升30%；装备者发动[普通攻击] 、[特殊技]或[追加攻击]命中敌人时，可分别获得1层增益效果，每层增益效果使装备者的暴击伤害额外提升10%，最多叠加3层，持续30秒，每层效果单独结算持续时间，同一招式内最多触发一次；拥有3层增益效果时，装备者造成的电属性伤害提升20%。
refinements.descriptionEn: CRIT DMG is increased by 30%. When the equipper lands a hit with a Basic Attack, Special Attack, or Aftershock, they gain 1 stack of a buff. Each stack increases the equipper's CRIT DMG by an additional 10%, stacking up to 3 times. The effect lasts for 30s, with each stack's duration calculated separately, and can only be triggered once per use of a skill. With all 3 stacks, the equipper's Electric DMG increases by 20%.

basic.name: 普通攻击：电击穿
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段斩击，造成电属性伤害；
第四段攻击命中敌人后，连点或长按 【普通攻击键】 时，可以快速穿过前方敌人，最多重复发动5次。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to five slashes ahead, dealing Electric DMG. After the 4th attack hits the enemy, repeatedly press or hold [Basic Attack] to quickly pass through enemies in front up to 5 times.

special.name: 特殊技：星雷
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向斜前方快速突进，随后进行交叉斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Dash diagonally forward, then unleash a cross slash, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：极雷断空
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough energy, hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
将双剑拼接后向前方丢出进行高速斩击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式命中敌人时，将为[银星]充能至上限；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Combines her twin swords and throws them forward for a high-speed slash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will fully charge Silver Star.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：地闪回击
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Repeatedly slash enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：疾跃落雷
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前方跃起，随后快速俯冲并发动交叉斩击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Leap forward, then quickly dive and perform a cross slash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：斩空掠电
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力连斩，并追加落雷攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式命中敌人时，将为[银星]充能至上限；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Perform a powerful series of slashes at a large area in front, followed by a lightning strike, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will fully charge Silver Star.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.descriptionEn:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text: 零号·安比对拥有[银星]标记的敌人造成的伤害提升25%；敌方单位被施加[银星]标记后，受到的[追加攻击]暴击伤害额外提升，提升效果等同于零号·安比暴击伤害的30%。
facts.textEn: Soldier 0 - Anby's DMG against enemies with the Silver Star mark increases by 25%. After an enemy is marked with Silver Star, the CRIT DMG received from Aftershock attacks is further increased by 30% of Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT DMG.

cinema.name: 静滞电荷
cinema.description: 零号·安比发动[强化特殊技]命中敌人时，将会连续触发3次[白雷]的额外伤害，该效果不会消耗[白雷]层数。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Soldier 0 - Anby uses an EX Special Attack to hit an enemy, it triggers the additional DMG from White Thunder 3 times. This effect does not consume any White Thunder stacks.

cinema.name: 冗余协议
cinema.description:
零号·安比的暴击率提升12%；发动[终结技]时，零号·安比会获得6层[电鸣]（上限6层）；拥有[电鸣]后，零号·安比[特殊技：苍光]命中拥有[白雷]的敌人时，将改为消耗1层[电鸣]作为代替，同一招式命中多名敌人时最多消耗1层[电鸣]，消耗[电鸣]时仍会触发[白雷]的额外伤害；
激发潜能后，每消耗3层[电鸣]，下次发动[特殊技：苍光·临界]时速度加快。
cinema.descriptionEn:
Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT Rate increases by 12%. When she uses her Ultimate, she gains 6 stacks of Thunder's Cry (max 6 stacks). With Thunder's Cry, when using Special Attack: Azure Flash to hit an enemy with White Thunder, it will consume 1 stack of Thunder's Cry instead. Only 1 stack of Thunder's Cry will be consumed when a single use of a skill hits multiple enemies, and consuming Thunder's Cry will still activate the additional DMG from White Thunder.
After activating potential, every 3 stacks of Thunder's Cry consumed, the next Special Attack: Azure Flash - Boundary will be activated faster.

cinema.name: 旧日荣光
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 银白残响
cinema.description: 攻击命中拥有[银星]标记的敌人时，零号·安比无视目标12%电属性伤害抗性。
cinema.descriptionEn: When hitting an enemy marked with Silver Star, Soldier 0 - Anby ignores 12% of the target's Electric RES.

cinema.name: 导演剪辑版
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 前传主角
cinema.description: 触发6次[白雷]的额外伤害时，将会引发电磁涡流，对目标及其周围的敌人造成零号·安比1000%攻击力的电属性伤害，该伤害被视为[追加攻击]伤害。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon triggering 6 instances of White Thunder's additional DMG, an electromagnetic vortex will be generated, dealing 1,000% of Soldier 0 - Anby's ATK as Electric DMG against the target and surrounding enemies. This DMG is considered Aftershock DMG.

每拥有三分之一充能，敌人将被施加1层[白雷]，最多叠加3层；

快速向前方位移，穿过敌人并进行斩击，对命中的敌人造成多段电属性伤害；
招式命中敌人时，将消耗1层[白雷]，发动[追加攻击]，造成1次额外的电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:

For every one-third of charge, the enemy receives 1 stack of White Thunder, stacking up to 3 times.
When the enemy has White Thunder, press [Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly dash forward, slashing through enemies and dealing multiple hits of Electric DMG.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will consume 1 stack of White Thunder to trigger an Aftershock that deals 1 extra instance of Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

138100004.name: 特殊技：苍光
138100004.description:
零号·安比攻击命中敌人时，会对目标施加[银星]标记，并为其进行充能；
每拥有三分之一充能，敌人将被施加1层[白雷]，最多叠加3层；
敌方目标拥有[白雷]时，点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
快速向前方位移，穿过敌人并进行斩击，对命中的敌人造成多段电属性伤害；
招式命中敌人时，将消耗1层[白雷]，发动[追加攻击]，造成1次额外的电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
138100004.descriptionEn:
When Soldier 0 - Anby's attacks hit an enemy, they apply the Silver Star mark and charges the target 
For every one-third of charge, the enemy receives 1 stack of White Thunder, stacking up to 3 times.
When the enemy has White Thunder, press [Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly dash forward, slashing through enemies and dealing multiple hits of Electric DMG.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will consume 1 stack of White Thunder to trigger an Aftershock that deals 1 extra instance of Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

138100007.name: 强化特殊技：极雷断空
138100007.description:
能量足够时，长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
将双剑拼接后向前方丢出进行高速斩击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式命中敌人时，将为[银星]充能至上限；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
138100007.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Combines her twin swords and throws them forward for a high-speed slash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will fully charge Silver Star.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

138100013.name: 终结技：斩空掠电
138100013.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力连斩，并追加落雷攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式命中敌人时，将为[银星]充能至上限；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
138100013.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Perform a powerful series of slashes at a large area in front, followed by a lightning strike, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the skill hits an enemy, it will fully charge Silver Star.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

138100016.name: 快速支援：云闪
138100016.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
138100016.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Repeatedly slash enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
